rejected_architecture: Same native comparison U, projector-controlled auxiliary processors with polynomially many output kicks, then complete computational signal/auxiliary readout and any classical guess: retaining failures does not rescue native near-entropy-width success.

input_access.supplied: One native phase batch, IID public labels, uniform independent full vector secret; optionally secret-independent joint classical physical-Z faults conditional on the labels.
input_access.known_gates: Public U and U inverse; input/output projector-controlled known auxiliary gates.
not_granted: arbitrary collective terminal measurement as a free decoder

mathematical_interfaces.raw_full_channel: Uniform public trial plus known phase corrections and legal individual measurements; not a classical reconstruction of quantum inputs.
mathematical_interfaces.hybrid: Whole-state distance to an auxiliary-only modified reference is at most2k sqrt(h_A), including all failures.
mathematical_interfaces.source_gate: Native mean complete-record correctness <=sqrt(B)+2k sqrt((N+G-1)/(NG)), capped at1.
mathematical_interfaces.phase_fault_gate: Fiber signed sums bound corrupted herald by clean h_A; local-reference source gate additionally requires secret independence conditional on A.
mathematical_interfaces.precision_gate: A separately proved total output trace-error budget adds to the ideal correctness bound; do not call finite-precision output exponentially small without that proof.

proof_obligations.PO-REVIEW: Independently review full-channel factorization, reference-prefix telescoping, source averaging, correlated-fault purification and probability/error conventions.
proof_obligations.PO-ESCAPE: Specify an actual costed outside-class primitive: terminal collective basis, other signal operations, different encoding or charged additional source.
proof_obligations.PO-NATURAL-SOURCE: Verify label law, full-secret prior or an explicitly different natural promise, physical fault lineage and gate precision. A uniform-secret converse is not automatically a short-secret lattice theorem.
proof_obligations.PO-TERMINAL: A named collective readout is not an implementation. Show its circuit and demonstrate why its reference output is not merely the legal local baseline.
proof_obligations.PO-CLASSICAL: Retain all failed outputs, auxiliary records, input costs and matched record decoders. Unknown-secret probability scoring is calibration, not a fast baseline solver.
proof_obligations.PO-SCOPE: Direct binary Hadamards and arbitrary collective data operations remain open. No general QSVT, DHSP, lattice or noisy-input hardness is claimed.

experiments_with_falsifiers.experiment: Execute full declared projector/auxiliary instruments and independent-language raw/local, mixed-fault and hybrid checks.
experiments_with_falsifiers.falsifier: An allowed complete channel violates the common gate, failure probabilities were normalized away, or a processor/source operation falls outside the declared algebra.

experiments_with_falsifiers.experiment: Construct a terminal collective decoder or changed source geometry with polynomial costs.
experiments_with_falsifiers.falsifier: The terminal procedure requires fiber advice, exponential preprocessing, unknown preparation inverses or restores only a different local channel.

experiments_with_falsifiers.experiment: Audit actual natural secret promises and source correlations before transferring the uniform-secret screen.
experiments_with_falsifiers.falsifier: A promised short/structured secret or secret-correlated side record invalidates the full uniform conditional prior.
